claim: P2-0 (closed upper half-plane: W_l(w) = 0 with Im w >= 0 iff (l, w) = (0, 0)) and D4 (m_0(0) = 1)

steps.statement: e^{-i w T}[(r^2 F R')' + (w^2 r^2/F - L) R] - E[u] == 0 for R = e^{i w T} u, T' = eta/F
steps.method: sympy simplify/expand == 0, generic F, eta, u, T

steps.statement: conj(u) E[u] = J' - r^2F|u'|^2 - 2w r^2 eta Im(u' conj u) + w^2 r^2(1-eta^2)/F |u|^2 - L|u|^2
steps.method: sympy expand == 0, u = p + i q, w = a + i b

steps.statement: Re/Im of 0 = i w B - D - 2wX + w^2 W - L N
b Re - a Im = -[b(D + L N + |w|^2 W) + |w|^2 B]
Res_{r_+} T' = -1/(2 kappa_+), Res_{r_c} T' = -1/(2 kappa_c)
indicial exponents of E[u]: {0, i w/kappa_+} at r_+, {0, i w/kappa_c} at r_c
D4: d/dw Delta(R_+R_c' - R_+'R_c) at (l,w)=(0,0) is i(r_+^2 + r_c^2)

written_steps.integration: u = e^{-i w T} R_+ is analytic on [r_+, r_c] when W_l(w) = 0 (C7 at r_+; R_+ = const*R_c and C7 at r_c), so D, N, X, W, B are finite (C6 bounds the W-weight) and integrating C2 over [r_+, r_c] with C3 gives 0 = i w B - D - 2 w X + w^2 W - L N (C4).
written_steps.b_pos: b > 0: by C5, b (D + L N + |w|^2 W) + |w|^2 B = 0 with every term >= 0, so W = 0 (w != 0); the weight of W is > 0 on (r_+, r_c) (C6), hence u = 0: no QNM with Im w > 0.
written_steps.b_zero: b = 0, a != 0: Im part of C4 gives a B = 0, so u(r_+) = 0, contradicting u_+(r_+) != 0 (C7).  w = 0: C4 gives D + L N = 0, so u' = 0 and (l >= 1) u = 0; for l = 0, u = const: the zero mode.
written_steps.D4: C8: W_0(0) = 0 (R = 1) and W_0'(0) = i (r_+^2 + r_c^2)/(r_+ r_c) != 0 (the exponential Jost factor is entire and does not change the order of the zero), so m_0(0) = 1.
